VanillaGravshipExpanded2.GravshipThreatD.label: Warplatform
VanillaGravshipExpanded2.GravshipThreatD.letterDesc:
An orbital bombardment platform has been activated by your gravship's energy signature. It is currently running target scans and will engage shortly. The orbital platform houses a sensitive warcomputer; destroying this component will disable the platform entirely.

The platform will continue to fire on your gravship until you move out of range or it is destroyed. Be aware that it takes time to fully engage; if you move away quickly enough, you may be able to escape its detection.

Point defense turrets, gravarmor, and shield generators can be used to protect against the bombardment. Gravship artillery can be used to attack the enemy over long distances. You can also send a shuttle or drop pods to the enemy location to handle it personally.
VanillaGravshipExpanded2.GravshipThreatD.arrivalLetterDesc: An orbital bombardment warplatform has arrived and is actively engaging your gravship. Your vessel will be under continuous fire from the platform's weapons. To survive, you must neutralize the platform either by destroying all gauss bombards, or destroying or hacking the central warcomputer.\n\nYou can fight back using your gravship's artillery, shield generators, and point defenses to withstand the bombardment. Alternatively, send a shuttle or drop pods to the enemy location to board the platform and destroy its sensitive internal warcomputer directly. If you cannot stop the bombardment, you must attempt to escape its range immediately.
VanillaGravshipExpanded2.GravshipThreatD.escapedMessage: You are now out of reach of the enemy warplatform.
VanillaGravshipExpanded2.GravshipThreatD.earlyEscapeMessage: You have moved out of range of the warplatform before it could engage. It will not pursue you further.
VanillaGravshipExpanded2.GravshipThreatD.defeatLetterDesc: Warplatform threat has been defeated, but the area still offers valuable loot. You can salvage the wreck of the warplatform to gain some valuable resources.\n\nWarplatform will destabilize and collapse within {0} days.
VanillaGravshipExpanded2.GravshipThreatD.disengagesLetterDesc: Warplatform has achieved all pre-programmed goals and has effectively destroyed your gravship. It has now disengaged.\n\nConsider this a valuable lesson.
VanillaGravshipExpanded2.GravshipThreatD.alertExplanation: An enemy warplatform has targeted {0}. It will continuously bombard the gravship until it is destroyed. Destroy or hack the internal warcomputer, or try and escape.
